title: Guest checkout abandonment and prominence in Baymard 2024
statement:
Guest checkout should be visibly available when account creation is not essential: Baymard's 2024 research found 18% of surveyed U.S. online shoppers had abandoned an order because they did not want to create an account, and 62% of benchmarked sites failed to make guest checkout the most prominent option. (Baymard Institute)

Options:
- Guest as primary: guest-checkout-primary-button (fits: low friction, new customer, conversion focused)
- Side-by-side choice: continue-as-guest-next-to-sign-in (fits: balanced, account optional, familiar)
- Create account later: defer-account-creation-to-confirmation (fits: low friction, mobile first, task focused)
- Optional account: account-optional-checkout (fits: privacy sensitive, customer control, low commitment)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, online retail, marketplaces, mobile commerce. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: Checkout UX 2025: 10 Pitfalls and Best Practices
